message.content: In Christian theology, **Jesus Christ** is regarded as the most significant prophetic figure. While the Old Testament contains many prophets—such as Moses, Isaiah, and Jeremiah—Christians believe that Jesus fulfills and surpasses all of them. He is seen as the ultimate revelation of God’s will, the one who brings the covenant to its fullest expression, and the central figure around whom Christian faith is built. Thus, Jesus is considered the paramount prophet—and, more than that, the Son of God—in Christian belief.
